I wrote the solution to `main.wj`. I ran Example 2 under `wj run --interpret` and the output matched. I didn't run Example 1 or build it with `wj build`, so the compiled path is untested.

It sieves primes up to 200000 once. It then precomputes the prime count and the largest prime at or below each `n`. Each query is a lookup. When there is no prime at or below `n`, it prints `0 none`.
